preconditions.description: The number of months for which Levian must account is between 2 and 500,000.
The number of incomes in the first half is between 1 and n/2, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: -10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9 for all i in range(len(first_half_incomes))
preconditions.description: Each income in the first half is between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.
The income in every month from ⌈{n/2}⌉ + 1 to n is between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (indicating no such k exists) or a valid k between 1 and n.
